svg.title: Two finite windows exclude a gap parameter
svg.desc: For a nonzero chain at b ell plus one less than t less than b ell, a length of two ell minus two would force a joint-kernel projection to vanish and lead by descent to the impossible identity F one equals zero. The tail from q ell to q two ell minus two is a spanning window of ell minus one generators.

g.text: Why a chain cannot reach length 2ℓ − 2
Gap: bℓ₊₁ < t < bℓ • every window of ℓ − 1 generators spans K
a spanning window of ℓ − 1 generators
Fℓ₋₁ commutes with every generator in the suffix
1. Positivity at aℓ₊₁ / aℓ < 0 gives Fℓ₋₁qℓ = 0.
2. Adjacent relations propagate the zero product along the suffix.
3. The suffix spans K, so Fℓ₋₁ = 0. Repeat with earlier kernels: F₁ = 0.
Contradiction: F₁ = 1 on nonzero K. Therefore L ≤ 2ℓ − 3.
Proof: Finite chains of Jones projections, §5. Index intervals are schematic; no trace is assumed.
